fnol_text: My name is Ethan Ueda and I live at 540 Marigold Terrace, Madison, WI 53742. You can reach me on (555) 812-3372 or ethan.ueda@example.com. On 10 May 2026 another car pulled out of a side road and hit my front passenger side. The other driver, Arjun Varga, admitted they didn't see me. Policy MT-2024-00077. adjuster_notes.text: Called Ms Ueda on (555) 812-3372 to acknowledge the claim. Ethan confirmed the loss date as 10 May 2026.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Liam Ballard gave a statement by phone.
